say:2:1630102001:1.text: This is where Professor Careel rests now...
say:2:1630102001:1.source_cn: 这里躺着我的老师，加内尔……
say:2:1630102001:1.male: This is where Professor Careel rests now...
say:2:1630102001:1.female: This is where Professor Careel rests now...

say:3:1630102002:1.text: To the world, he was just another scholar. To me, he was the one light I followed through the dark.
say:3:1630102002:1.source_cn: 他是群星中的一颗，却是我唯一的启明星。
say:3:1630102002:1.male: To the world, he was just another scholar. To me, he was the one light I followed through the dark.
say:3:1630102002:1.female: To the world, he was just another scholar. To me, he was the one light I followed through the dark.

say:4:1630102003:1.text: He didn't care about trophies or scores. "Stay curious," he'd say. "Magic dies when you stop wondering."
say:4:1630102003:1.source_cn: 老师总是和我说，取得好的排名并不重要，时刻保持对魔法的...
say:4:1630102003:1.male: He didn't care about trophies or scores. "Stay curious," he'd say. "Magic dies when you stop wondering."
say:4:1630102003:1.female: He didn't care about trophies or scores. "Stay curious," he'd say. "Magic dies when you stop wondering."

say:5:1630102004:1.text: Wonder is the best teacher—that's what he always said to me.
say:5:1630102004:1.source_cn: 兴趣是最好的老师……他常常这样讲。
say:5:1630102004:1.male: Wonder is the best teacher—that's what he always said to me.
say:5:1630102004:1.female: Wonder is the best teacher—that's what he always said to me.

say:6:1630102005:1.text: After he was gone, no one else had time for me—the slow kid.
say:6:1630102005:1.source_cn: 在他离世后，再没有哪个老师能如此耐心地对待我了。我很笨...
say:6:1630102005:1.male: After he was gone, no one else had time for me—the slow kid.
say:6:1630102005:1.female: After he was gone, no one else had time for me—the slow kid.

say:7:1630102006:1.text: But I made him a promise: I'd never stop loving magic, not even on my worst days.
say:7:1630102006:1.source_cn: 但我答应过老师，不论发生什么，我都会始终热爱魔法。
say:7:1630102006:1.male: But I made him a promise: I'd never stop loving magic, not even on my worst days.
say:7:1630102006:1.female: But I made him a promise: I'd never stop loving magic, not even on my worst days.
